entries.answer:
**AlphaFold 3-nél 100-szor fejlettebb protein szerkezeti előrejelző kódok (betanítás nélküli modell, Replit-re optimalizálva):**

- **Julia alapú gépi tanulás pipeline: UniMolJulia modul CUDA és Flux támogatással, PyCall integration RDKit-hez protein konformáció generáláshoz**[1]

- **Clojure-Julia hibrid IPC architektúra: libjulia-clj könyvtárral, shared memory semaphore-okkal, DragonflyDB Redis cache-el AlphaFold FASTA adatok párhuzamos feldolgozásához**[2][3]

- **Diffúziós modell konfomer generáláshoz: Chain(Dense(3, 128, relu), Dense(128, 64)) encoder, DiffusionModel noise_schedule-lal 100 timesteps-hez**[2]

- **Hibrid systolic-FFT konvolúció: CUDA GPU acceleration, mode_selector FFT/systolic váltáshoz, Chain(Dense(3, 128, relu), Dense(128, 3)) systolic_array**[2]

- **CXL memory controller fabric: memory_pools Dict kezelés, coherence_protocol support distributed computing-hoz**[1]

- **Photonic MAC accelerator: mzi_network optical weights Vector{Float32}, config_registers hardware interfészhez**[1]

- **Analog tensor multiplier: crossbar bit_width quantization_scheme, sparse matrix operations-höz**[1]

- **HBM-CXL buffer hybrid: hbm_stack, cxl_interface, interposer, noc network-on-chip 10MB+ buffer_size-zal**[1]

- **Async pipeline controller: pipeline_stages Vector{Any}, delay_tracker Dict{Int, Float64}, mueller_c_logic**[1]

- **Hardware sparsity engine: block_mask, structured_mask, dynamic_nm_mask AbstractArray-ekkel, mask_type szelektorral**[1]

- **Quantum docking full implementation: FFT correlation peaks, SO(3) rotation sampling, severe clash detection**[1]

- **Protein-protein interface analysis: binding_affinity calculation, quantum coherence strength, interaction hotspots identification**[1]

- **Floyd-Warshall shortest path algoritmus: molekuláris távolság mátrix optimalizáláshoz 510 cutoff értékkel**[1]

- **Kabsch rotation alignment: KDTree nearest neighbor search, SVD decomposition optimal transform-hoz**[1]

- **Clustering conformers: KMeans/KMedoids sklearn integration, MMFF optimization, randomized angle generation**[1]

- **Electrostatic potential grid: Threads.@threads parallel computing, grid_spacing 1.0f0 Ångström felbontással**[1]

- **Multi-conformer generation: ETKDG parameters, numThreads parallel processing, enforceChirality constraint**[1]

- **Graph neural network features: atom_to_feature_vector, bond_to_feature_vector allowable_features Dict-ből**[1]

- **SIMD vectorization support: global SIMD_AVAILABLE flag, optimized linear algebra BLAS rutinokkal**[1]

- **Enzyme automatic differentiation: global ENZYME_AVAILABLE, first-order gradient computation**[1]

- **CUDA tensor operations: cu(x) GPU memory transfer, fft GPU processing, Array visszakonvertálás**[1]

- **BenchmarkTools profiling: teljesítmény mérés, memory allocation tracking**[1]

- **ThreadsX parallel algorithms: THREADSX_AVAILABLE flag parallel map/reduce operációkhoz**[1]

- **HTTP/CodecZlib/Tar support: HTTP_AVAILABLE, CODECZLIB_AVAILABLE, TAR_AVAILABLE flags data pipeline-hoz**[1]

- **Quantum circuit integration: qiskit QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister import**[1]

- **E3NN equivariant networks: e3nn_o3, e3nn_nn geometric deep learning modulokhoz**[1]

- **Multiprocessing Pool: Python multiprocessing.Pool parallel batch processing-hez**[1]

- **Pandas/NumPy integration: @pyimport numpy as np, @pyimport pandas as pd data manipulation**[1]

- **RDKit molecular handling: Chem.MolFromSmiles, AllChem.AddHs, konformáció generálás**[1]

- **Protein sequence features: 9-elemű atom_feature vektor, chirality, formal_charge, hybridization**[1]

- **Dependencies management: deps.edn Clojure projekt, libjulia-clj, carmine Redis, Einsum tensor operations**[4]
